title: Four Revelation Lens
principle: A cross-reference framework for the August 2026 observatory. References are used as theological comparison points for Tawhid, not as evidence that a text directly describes the modern event.

traditions.name: Al-Qur'an
traditions.focus: Allah is One; worship and invocation belong to Allah.

traditions.name: Injil / Gospel
traditions.focus: The Lord is one; worship and service are directed to God.

traditions.name: Taurat / Torah
traditions.focus: The Lord is one; no other gods or idols are to take His place.

traditions.name: Zabur / Psalms
traditions.focus: God alone is God; idols are not the true source of power.
